ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity white regions to 55% low-intensity black/grey pigmented regions across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: large contiguous white region from lower center to mid-wing, bounded by dense black mottling on the trailing edge. Right lobe: dense, fragmented black linear streaks and speckles distributed over a white background, with concentrated dark pigmentation on the upper-outer quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 80 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the visible lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; prominent distal peaks and valleys visible at the terminal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve with a pronounced upward distal sweep; outer edges transition into jagged, irregular terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible cluster of ~12-15 high-intensity circular nodes on the far right distal tip; smaller cluster of ~3 nodes on the far left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions; prominent 45-degree diagonal mark on the mid-left lobe and vertical rake-like parallel streaks on the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of sessile organisms (barnacles) on distal tips; extensive rake marks and linear scarring on the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-frequency 'brush-stroke' pigmentation pattern on the right lobe, characterized by fine black linear density over a white substrate.
